# flow-ir

> An engine-agnostic intermediate representation (IR) for business processes, plus a multi-engine adapter
> toolchain: `flow.json` is the source of truth, and **only one adapter is implemented today — PAD
> (Power Automate Desktop / Robin)**. Other engines (another RPA product, cloud flows, Python/VBS) are
> extension points that are not implemented yet. Adapter code lives in `tools/pad-robin/` and `tools/pad-sync/`.

## Layers

| Layer | Contents | Location |
|---|---|---|
| Engine-agnostic IR checks | Canvas vs `edges` consistency, requirement-level structural assertions, public-content scanning, general utilities | `tools/flow-drawio/`, `tools/pad-robin/eval-flow.js`, `tools/publish/`, `tools/workday/`, `tools/xlsx/` |
| PAD adapter | `.robin` generation, artifact static checks, admission, injection, publishing, rollback, scheduling, telemetry, acceptance | `tools/pad-robin/flow-to-robin.js`, `tools/pad-sync/` |

`.robin` is an artifact of the PAD adapter, not the IR itself. IR structures — nodes, edges, `guard`, `budget`,
idempotency, reversibility, `trigger` — are not bound to any engine.

## Getting started

```powershell
.\tools\check-env.ps1    # verify Node / Git / PowerShell first
.\setup.ps1              # Node deps + pre-commit gate + clone the PAD action knowledge base
```

To verify the environment: `.\examples\smoke.ps1` (canvas → generate → static check → admission → structural
evaluation in one run; needs no `business/`, no action knowledge base and no `node_modules`; exits 0 when green).

Then walk through `docs/nl-to-flow-guide.md`: requirement → `flow.json` → generate → static check → admission.

## Red lines

1. Never invent actions or parameters: `pad_hint` must be a real three-part `actionId` from the action knowledge base, and `params` keys must be that action's real parameter names.
2. Side effects must be skippable: sending mail, posting documents and deleting files go inside `guard`, and `flow.json` must declare a `budget`.
3. `business/` is never committed and never public: the whole directory is ignored, and both the pre-push gate and the public-content scan block it.
4. Three things are never automated away: recording UI elements, fabricating SAP recording artifacts, publishing to production.
5. A trigger declares only `kind` (`manual` / `schedule` / `file`); the legacy `type`/`config` shape is reported as `TRIGGER_LEGACY_SHAPE`.
